knowledge.title: Hotel profile
knowledge.answer: Lunara Grand Hotel & Residences is a five-star urban lifestyle hotel at 88 Meridian Drive, Aurora Bay District, Metro Manila, Philippines. The property has 228 rooms and suites.

knowledge.title: Check-in and checkout
knowledge.answer: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM and checkout is 12:00 PM. Early arrival and late checkout are subject to availability and confirmation.

knowledge.title: Pool
knowledge.answer: The Infinity Pool, children's pool, and pool deck are on Level 3 and are open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

knowledge.title: Fitness Center
knowledge.answer: The Fitness Center is on Level 3 and is open 24 hours for registered guests.

knowledge.title: Lunara Spa
knowledge.answer: Lunara Spa is on Level 3 and is open from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Treatments require confirmation.

knowledge.title: Dining
knowledge.answer: Lunara dining includes Solace Kitchen and Drift Cafe on the Ground Floor, plus Halo Rooftop Bar and the Executive Lounge on Level 16.

knowledge.title: Hotel services
knowledge.answer: The Front Desk is available 24 hours, Concierge from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, and room service 24 hours. I can prepare a service request for your confirmation.

knowledge.title: Emergency assistance
knowledge.answer: For an emergency, contact local emergency services and hotel staff immediately. The concierge will escalate the matter without delay.
